hero: All eight New Zealand universities rank in the global top 3%, with small class sizes, strong pastoral care and a three-year post-study work visa for degree graduates.
intro:
New Zealand is an increasingly popular study destination for international students, offering a high-quality education system, a strong international reputation and a wide range of career-focused programs.

As New Zealand's economy has evolved beyond its traditional agricultural base towards a more diverse and service-driven economy, there are growing opportunities in areas such as Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
why: Up to 3 years post-study work for degree holders
Lower cost of living than Australia
visa: Fee Paying Student visa — Requirements for visa include admission/acceptance from a recognised institution, evidence of tuition fee payment or ability to pay, proof of sufficient funds for living expenses, medical assessment, PCC and ITRs of sponsors.
intakes: February and July intakes. Apply 6–8 months ahead.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 60%+ in bachelor's; 3-year degrees accepted for PG diplomas

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0

req.label: Funds
req.value: NZD 20,000 per year of living costs plus tuition

req.label: Documents
req.value: SOP, LORs, transcripts, passport, medicals, insurance

sch.name: New Zealand Excellence Awards
sch.text: NZD 5,000 – 10,000 for Indian students across all eight universities

sch.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
sch.text: Fully funded government awards including living allowance

steps.title: Accept the offer
steps.text: Pay tuition and receive your Offer of Place

steps.title: Arrange insurance
steps.text: Buy approved travel and medical insurance

steps.title: Complete medicals
steps.text: Chest x-ray and general medical with a panel physician

steps.title: Apply online
steps.text: Lodge the Fee Paying Student visa with funds evidence

work: Students can work 20 hours a week during study and full time in scheduled breaks. Degree graduates receive a Post Study Work visa of up to 3 years, and Green List occupations offer a fast track to residence.
workPoints: Post Study Work visa up to 3 years
